question: Was refund 1120894320887 created by a staff member in Shopify Admin (a potential G-AGREEMENT NEG, which with its MergeShip-attributed RefundAgreement would be NEGATIVE under §12.8.2)?

finding.createdBy: an agent-run Protocol v2 live-verification driver (Scenario 5A, 2026-10-04T19:48:00Z), not a staff member in Shopify Admin
finding.credentials: MergeShip's own app credentials: the session's direct GraphQL transport acquired its token through the Shopify client-credentials grant for client id 04b77142ce8ad421f49735b05c7d0a86 (MergeShip) and logged `authentication: client_credentials, outcome: ACQUIRED` for the run that sent the refund
finding.consequence: The refund is app-created. It cannot serve as the §12.8.1 NEG control (staff-created in Admin), so the potential NEGATIVE outcome cannot be established from it. Its monetary-only manual-gateway shape (no shipping line) is also not a comparable POS. Part A stays INCONCLUSIVE.
finding.notUsedAsEvidence: The RefundAgreement app.id and the manual gateway in q-agreements-neg_1099.json / q-refund-detail-five_ids.json were NOT used to infer the creator; they are merely consistent with this finding.
